dockerfile.description: Un-ignore test directories for the dockerfile manager only. `github>owine/renovate-config` -> default.json -> config:best-practices -> config:recommended -> :ignoreModulesAndTests sets a top-level ignorePaths that includes `**/tests/**`, which silently hid tests/e2e/visual.Dockerfile from its introduction in #171 until #323 found it pinned to a Playwright image two minors behind the npm client — the container failed at browser launch with `Executable doesn't exist`. An untracked file produces no PR, no error, and no Dependency Dashboard entry, so nothing ever reports it. This re-lists the inherited paths minus the three test-directory globs. It is manager-scoped on purpose: a top-level ignorePaths would replace the preset's list for EVERY manager, so npm and github-actions would start scanning fixture manifests under tests/. Kept local rather than pushed to the shared preset — un-ignoring test dirs fleet-wide off one data point is too broad.

regex.description: Same un-ignore as the `dockerfile` block above, applied to the custom regex manager. NOT redundant with it: managers are separate config namespaces, so un-ignoring test dirs for `dockerfile` does nothing for this one. The Alpine apk manager below matches `/Dockerfile$/`, which also matches tests/e2e/visual.Dockerfile, yet it inherits the preset's `**/tests/**` ignore independently. No live impact today — the visual harness pins no apk packages — but adding one there would be silently untracked, reproducing the #171 -> #323 failure exactly. The key is `regex`, not `custom.regex`: that is the name Renovate's own schema registers this manager under for config scoping, and `ignorePaths` is rejected inline on a customManagers entry. **The two ignorePaths lists must stay in sync** — editing one does not propagate to the other.

customManagers.description: Track pinned Alpine apk packages against the Alpine CDN package index via the shared `custom.alpine` datasource (supplied by `github>owine/renovate-config:alpine` — do not define a customDatasources block here). IMPORTANT: bump alpine version in depNameTemplate when the base image changes (e.g. alpine_3_23 -> alpine_3_24); the preset derives the CDN release-line URL from that prefix, so it is still a one-line edit. The preset points at /main/x86_64/ — a package that lives in the Alpine *community* index needs a per-repo packageRule overriding registryUrls, and is otherwise SILENTLY untracked: no warning, no dashboard entry. Both pins here (curl, postgresql18-client) are main-index packages, verified 2026-08-19. extractVersionTemplate is load-bearing: the html format turns every href in the directory listing into a candidate, and the `\d` anchor after the package name stops a pin matching a longer sibling (gd vs gd-dev). Its test-directory un-ignore lives in the top-level `regex` block, not here — custom managers reject an inline `ignorePaths`.

packageRules.description: GitGuardian (action + ggshield CLI) must stay version-consistent

The Playwright npm client and the visual-harness base image must stay version-consistent — a mismatch makes the container fail at browser launch with 'Executable doesn't exist'. Deliberately excludes @axe-core/playwright, which versions independently.
